scope: Conditional offer selection and counterexample audit; no physical operations or market bids.
physical_preparation: Exactly the v4 prepared model. Do not widen limits or change control assumptions.
reuse: Reuse only full curves with exactly identical physical inputs. Qualify every record by its source file. All new evaluations retained.
baseline_gate: If the equal-demand Cruiserath baseline has no checked point under the wind ceiling, block the pair. No need to run unused candidate curves for that condition.
search: Same coarse grid and 0.25 MW refinement as v4, best tested points only; no interpolation between load levels.
comparison: Same wind ceiling, demand amount, line and controls within each pair. Less delivered flexibility lowers both counterfactual loads. It is not a chronological unmet-work simulation.
cost: Illustrative reservation cost: full quoted 20 MW times assumed duration times site premium, even if delivery is lower. No rebate, penalty, market settlement or customer profit inferred.
decision: Nominal maximum added wind subject to budget and site availability. Guarded choice maximizes minimum tested added wind across user-required scenarios, with valid physical pairs, budget, user benefit floor and optional nonnegative scenario surplus.
data_priority: Rank dimensions by tested counterexamples and recommendation changes, not a probabilistic information-value estimate.
measurement: Physical record coverage, nominal/guarded case-grid outcomes, retained benefit, abstention, lookup count and timing. No AI accuracy before actual Azure access.
ai: Bounded counterexample selection using a dedicated tool. Compare against fixed and seeded-random orders at the same record-read budget. All Azure results remain not_run until credentials.
